per_candidate.id: s2:GW170817: A Short Review of the First Multimessenger Event in Gravitational Astr
s2:Simulating Short Gamma-Ray Burst Jets in Realistic Late Binary Neutron Star Merg

rationale: The papers 2507.04318 and 2304.04009 propose a neutron star-white dwarf merger as a potential mechanism for GRB 211211A, while 2304.00893 suggests a neutron star-black hole merger. Paper 2510.09744 investigates the absence of a magnetar remnant, contributing to understanding the emissions. These studies provide substantive evidence on potential mechanisms but do not fully resolve the question.
